## What changed

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `./packaging/build-deb.sh`, or explained why a full package build
      is not applicable.
- [ ] I tested visible GNOME Shell behavior affected by this change.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated user-facing documentation where needed.
- [ ] I removed private session data, document paths, credentials and unrelated
      generated files from this pull request.

## GNOME checks

List the Ubuntu version, GNOME Shell version, Wayland/X11 session and manual
save/restore or extension checks performed. Write “not applicable” for a
documentation-only change.

## Limitations

Describe known edge cases, follow-up work or compatibility that was not tested.
